title: BMUnun to the rector of Japanin Kyrgyzstandagi elchisi menen zholuktu

blocks.text: 2025-zhildyn 18-Julyunda Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin to the rector Mirlan Dyldaev Japan mamleketinin Kyrgyzstandagi yigarym ukuktuu elchisi Hideki Goda myrza menen rasmiy zholugushuu otkөrdү. Zholugushuu Japan elchiliginin imaratynda өtүp, taraptar eki өlkөnүn madaniy aralyk kyzmattashuusu tuuraluu pikir alyshty. Өzgөchө kөңүl Bishkek mamlekettik universityininin Yapon taanuu bolumүn onүkturүү, student menen okutuuchulardyn almashuusu, birgeleshken madaniy ish-charalardy өtkөruү mүmkүnchүlүktөrү talkkuulandy. Mirlan Dyldaev BMUnun Japan tili zhana madaniyaty boyuncha zhүrgүzүp zhatkan ishterine toktolup, bul bagytty dagı terendetuugo dayar ekenin bildirdi. Oz keseginde, elchi Hideki Goda myrza universitytin demilgelerin kubattap, Japan tarap kyzmattashuuga kyzykdar ekenin basa belgilep, zhyyntygynda taraptar kelechekte eki taraptuu baylanyshtardy terendetuugo makuldashty.
